object.attr: derived: CF-E29. Windows finds a program looked up by bare name in the current folder first, and the MCP server usually runs in the repository, so a program in a pulled commit would run (D-E19). Accepted on 2026-11-13 as a security fix after the code view (CV-PDF-11: the draw.io lookup found a program committed to the current folder); to confirm with the person (open question Q20).
object.description: When Mellon looks for draw.io desktop, Mellon shall leave out programs inside the repository and programs directly in the current folder, other than a program that MELLON_DRAWIO names.
